主要内容: On July 12, 2016, Nicholas Financial Inc's Compensation Committee awarded cash bonuses for the year ended March 31, 2016, of $32,500, $25,000, and $17,500 to Ralph T. Finkenbrink, Kevin D. Bates, and Katie L. MacGillivary, respectively. The company also announced a cash bonus program for Fiscal 2017, effective April 1, 2016, with maximum bonus amounts of 35%, 25%, and 25% of annual base salary for the executives. The non-discretionary component is based on the Cash Target Allocation, which is 17.5%, 12.5%, and 12.5% of annual base salary. The Overall Payout Factor ranges from 0% to 150%, depending on performance metrics: operating expenses as a percentage of average finance receivables and the write-off to liquidation ratio. The discretionary component is capped at 17.5% and 12.5% of base salary. The Compensation Committee also awarded performance-based awards and time-vested stock awards under the 2015 Omnibus Incentive Plan for Fiscal 2017, with vesting on March 31, 2019.
